children: Crescent Energy announced an underwritten offering of Class A common stock raising about $1.12 billion net after upsized exercise.
Announced $1.0B underwritten offering of Class A common stock from an effective Form S-3 shelf registration.
Priced 80,000,000 shares at $12.50 per share; underwriters' 30-day option for 12,000,000 shares was exercised in full.
KKR‑affiliated Independence Energy Aggregator agreed to purchase 40,000,000 shares at the public price.
Expected to receive ≈ $1,115.9M net proceeds after discounts, commissions and expenses.
Net proceeds intended to fund portion of the cash consideration for the Devon Eagle Ford assets acquisition; interim use to reduce revolver borrowings.
